nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: Why do cocoa farms pose a classification challenge in Nigeria?
nodes.answer: Cocoa farms have rarely been differentiated from other land covers in Nigeria due to their similar spatial signature to open canopy forests and a high chance of misclassification.

nodes.answer: Conservation Agriculture scored 78/100 and Agroforestry scored 71/100 as the top-rated solutions.
